system.description:
You clasp your hands together pointing your fingers in any direction of your choice firing them all at once with enough of a combined force to rip through even chakra barriers. You fire bone bullets like a shotgun burst in a 30-foot cone originating from you.

All creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 4d6 piercing damage and gains 2 ranks of Bleeding on a failed save or half as much damage and no additional effects on a success. Barriers are treated as vulnerable to this jutsu’s damage.

Battle Lust: By spending 2 Battle Lust as part of this jutsu’s casting you change the range of this jutsu to Self (60-foot line). Creatures in this new range that fail their saving throw become Staggered.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
